mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(transaction_row.out_amount), 0) FROM ACCOUNT account_row INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION transaction_row ON transaction_row.account_id = account_row.account_id INNER JOIN TXN_ANALYSIS analysis_row ON analysis_row.account_transaction_id = transaction_row.account_transaction_id WHERE account_row.user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_row.tran_date >= #{startDate} AND transaction_row.tran_date < #{endDate} AND analysis_row.is_consumption = TRUE

SELECT analysis_row.category AS category, COALESCE(SUM(transaction_row.out_amount), 0) AS expenseAmount FROM ACCOUNT account_row INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION transaction_row ON transaction_row.account_id = account_row.account_id INNER JOIN TXN_ANALYSIS analysis_row ON analysis_row.account_transaction_id = transaction_row.account_transaction_id WHERE account_row.user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_row.tran_date >= #{startDate} AND transaction_row.tran_date < #{endDate} AND analysis_row.is_consumption = TRUE GROUP BY analysis_row.category ORDER BY analysis_row.category

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(transaction_row.out_amount), 0) FROM ACCOUNT account_row INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TRANSACTION transaction_row ON transaction_row.account_id = account_row.account_id INNER JOIN TXN_ANALYSIS analysis_row ON analysis_row.account_transaction_id = transaction_row.account_transaction_id WHERE account_row.user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_row.tran_date >= #{startDate} AND transaction_row.tran_date < #{endDate} AND analysis_row.is_consumption = TRUE AND analysis_row.expense_type = 'FIXED'
